svg.title: Governed Execution Surface
svg.desc: A governed workspace mockup with a prominent top ribbon, prompt area on the left, output preview in the center, and telemetry panel on the right.
svg.text: A visible meter sits above the work instead of behind it.

g.text: Users can still change the work before capacity is consumed.
The center pane shows results without hiding the operating signal.
The side rail exposes actual usage and threshold posture.
Shorten prompt and route after review
